title: Grid Sperner needs resolution width Theta(m)
claim: Grid Sperner needs resolution width Theta(m). For 2D Sperner on the side-m triangular grid with the fixed boundary of FLAT-STATES-20261107-001B (one-sided or two-sided), every resolution refutation has width at least c*m - 1 for an absolute constant c > 0, and O(m) suffices. Duplicator keeps the full triangle at distance at least C*w from the boundary (w the pebble budget) and outside the density-bad set. Boundary lemma: in a negative cycle of the window criterion, negative terms come only from single edges between pebbles that touch a Spoiler pebble or one of finitely many boundary features, so a certificate walk through boundary pebbles stays within distance O(w) of the boundary and cannot separate two deep triangles; walks avoiding the boundary have length O(pebbles), and the density argument of SPHERE-WIDTH-20261107-001A applies.
failure_conditions: A certificate with a negative term at a segment of distance > 1, or at one touching neither a Spoiler pebble nor a boundary feature, or whose positive terms exceed the negative count minus one.
A certificate walk that neither separates the two triangles nor meets the old one, or a boundary-free walk longer than 2r - 3 + |H|.
A consistent pebble set that blocks a triangle far from every pebble and from the boundary.
A gap in the hand proof (boundary lemma, winding bound, planar isoperimetry).
foundation_claim_scope: The side-m Sperner grid with the fixed three-sided boundary, every m (by the proof); certificates checked for m = 10, 12; locality for m = 18.

validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the repository owner's request on 2026-11-07.
validation.status: the theorem by hand from SPHERE-WIDTH-20261107-001A's argument plus the boundary lemma; certificate structure and locality checked by computation; no human or external review
validation.novelty: new as far as found: Sperner's tree-like resolution size and query complexity are known (Itsykson-Malova-Oparin-Sokolov; Crescenzi-Silvestri); a general-resolution width bound for grid Sperner was not found.
